import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 25;
    static final int oo = (int)1e4 + 7;
    static int[][] dis = new int[N][N];
    static String[] s;
    static String[] t;
    static int n, k;
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static List<int[]> source = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<int[]> sink = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[][][][][] dp = new int[65][12][12][12][12];

    // Edge structure
    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        int cap, flow;
        Edge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    // PushRelabel class
    static class PushRelabel {
        int N;
        List<Edge> edges;
        List<List<Integer>> G;
        int[] h;
        int[] inQ;
        int[] count;
        int[] excess;
        Queue<Integer> Q;

        PushRelabel(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            G = new ArrayList<>(N);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                G.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            h = new int[N];
            inQ = new int[N];
            count = new int[2 * N];
            excess = new int[N];
            Q = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        int addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            G.get(from).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(from, to, cap));
            G.get(to).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(to, from, 0));
            return G.get(from).get(G.get(from).size() - 1);
        }

        void enQueue(int u) {
            if (inQ[u] == 0 && excess[u] > 0) {
                Q.add(u);
                inQ[u] = 1;
            }
        }

        void push(int edgeIdx) {
            Edge e = edges.get(edgeIdx);
            int toPush = Math.min(e.cap - e.flow, excess[e.from]);
            if (toPush > 0 && h[e.from] > h[e.to]) {
                e.flow += toPush;
                excess[e.to] += toPush;
                excess[e.from] -= toPush;
                edges.get(edgeIdx ^ 1).flow -= toPush;
                enQueue(e.to);
            }
        }

        void relabel(int u) {
            count[h[u]] -= 1;
            h[u] = 2 * N - 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < G.get(u).size(); i++) {
                Edge e = edges.get(G.get(u).get(i));
                if (e.cap > e.flow) {
                    h[u] = Math.min(h[u], h[e.to]);
                }
            }
            count[++h[u]] += 1;
        }

        void gapRelabel(int height) {
            for (int u = 0; u < N; u++) {
                if (h[u] >= height && h[u] < N) {
                    count[h[u]] -= 1;
                    count[h[u] = N] += 1;
                    enQueue(u);
                }
            }
        }

        void discharge(int u) {
            for (int i = 0; excess[u] > 0 && i < G.get(u).size(); i++) {
                push(G.get(u).get(i));
            }
            if (excess[u] > 0) {
                if (h[u] < N && count[h[u]] < 2) {
                    gapRelabel(h[u]);
                } else {
                    relabel(u);
                }
            } else if (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                Q.poll();
                inQ[u] = 0;
            }
        }

        int getFlow(int src, int snk) {
            h[src] = N;
            inQ[src] = 1;
            inQ[snk] = 1;
            count[0] = N - (count[N] = 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < G.get(src).size(); i++) {
                excess[src] += edges.get(G.get(src).get(i)).cap;
                push(G.get(src).get(i));
            }
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                discharge(Q.peek());
            }
            return excess[snk];
        }
    }

    // BFS
    static void bfs(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dis[x][y] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{x, y});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            x = cur[0];
            y = cur[1];
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                int xx = x + dx[j];
                int yy = y + dy[j];
                if (xx < 0 || xx >= n) continue;
                if (yy < 0 || yy >= n) continue;
                if (dis[xx][yy] != -1) continue;
                if (t[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Y' || t[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Z') continue;
                dis[xx][yy] = dis[x][y] + 1;
                q.add(new int[]{xx, yy});
            }
        }
    }

    // pos function (DP)
    static int pos(int t, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (dis[x0][y0] < t) return 0;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return 1;
        if (t >= k) return 0;
        if (dis[x0][y0] <= t) return 0;
        if (dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return dp[t][x0][y0][x][y];
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            int xx = x0 + dx[j];
            int yy = y0 + dy[j];
            if (xx < 0 || xx >= n) continue;
            if (yy < 0 || yy >= n) continue;
            if (s[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Y') continue;
            if (s[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Z') continue;
            if (pos(t + 1, xx, yy, x, y) == 1) {
                dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
                return 1;
            }
        }
        dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
        return 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Initialize dp
        for (int a = 0; a < 65; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 12; b++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < 12; c++) {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 12; d++) {
                        Arrays.fill(dp[a][b][c][d], -1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        s = new String[n];
        t = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s[i] = sc.nextLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            t[i] = sc.nextLine();
        }
        int x = -1, y = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (t[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    x = i;
                    y = j;
                }
            }
        }
        bfs(x, y);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (dis[i][j] == -1) {
                    dis[i][j] = oo;
                }
            }
        }

        // Build source and sink lists
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = s[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Z' || c == 'Y' || c == '0') continue;
                source.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = t[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Z' || c == 'Y' || c == '0') continue;
                sink.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }

        PushRelabel g = new PushRelabel(source.size() + sink.size() + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < source.size(); i++) {
            int srcVal = s[source.get(i)[0]].charAt(source.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            g.addEdge(0, i + 1, srcVal);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sink.size(); i++) {
            int snkVal = t[sink.get(i)[0]].charAt(sink.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            g.addEdge(source.size() + i + 1, source.size() + sink.size() + 1, snkVal);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < source.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sink.size(); j++) {
                if (pos(0, source.get(i)[0], source.get(i)[1], sink.get(j)[0], sink.get(j)[1]) == 1) {
                    g.addEdge(i + 1, source.size() + j + 1, oo);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(g.getFlow(0, source.size() + sink.size() + 1));
    }
}
